msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia my-charlotte-18.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a mustard and brown printed button midi dress with a red bead necklace from the reference, walking at a sunny street in El Puerto de Santa María, Cádiz, Spain, with white houses, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia my-charlotte-04.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a burgundy knit jumper with mustard stitching from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia my-charlotte-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a brown and cream striped knit jumper with beige trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia my-charlotte-17.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a purple satin blouse and trousers set with frog buttons from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia my-charlotte-19.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a colourful striped ethnic print top and skirt set from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.

IMAGEN 4 «l2» (formato 3:4, referencia my-charlotte-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Lifestyle photo: a taupe suede bag with long fringe on a striped knit jumper, close up, like in the reference, soft natural light, editorial, warm and inviting, shallow depth of field. IMAGEN 5 «b» (formato 16:9, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA C): Wide interior photo: the inside of a boho fashion boutique with white walls, pampas grass, a rattan mirror, rails of knitwear and a light counter, no people, no text, inspired by the reference, photographed like a design magazine, beautiful natural light, inviting and tidy. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage.
